approval: Owner delegated the proposed targets and original-event replay choice; isolated synthetic lab only
storage: Encrypted data and key bundles in separate access-controlled off-host stores; decryption private keys held separately. Lab uses separate disposable external temporary directories; no off-host service or scheduler is provisioned.
rtoClock: From restore request before bundle authentication through DB/broker restore, startup, replay if approved, API replay and full drain/invariant audit; backup creation and subsequent negative/duplicate controls measured separately
rpoClock: Age of the consistent DB snapshot at simulated loss; exact checkpoint equality, not a claim to recover commits after the snapshot. No WAL/PITR.
